conviction_note: Primary documents put Q1 FY5/27 ordinary profit at about ¥950-1,050m. The seasonal bar is ¥938m (17.6% of the ¥5,330m guide). Building-confirmation volume is up 3.5% with per-unit revenue flat, so that line is lapped; completion-inspection unit fees are still catching up, about +17% YoY per unit. That makes the number a modest beat (+1.0 finding). I emit +0.5, half the finding, because YoY growth drops from +35% to the low teens, the stock is at an all-time high after a 防災庁 theme bid, and margin longs sit at 8x. This name sold a no-raise print −15% in March 2026 and does not pay for in-line beats.
bar: Company guide FY5/27 ordinary profit ¥5,330m, revenue ¥27,000m. No H1 or quarterly guide is disclosed. The Q1 bar is the seasonal share: last year Q1 ordinary ¥877m was 17.6% of the full year, so 17.6% × 5,330 = ¥938m. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713591776.pdf (決算短信 2026-07-14, 今後の見通し). No sell-side consensus is sourced. The Q1 bar is derived from the company guide, so sizes are kept small.

findings.finding: ERI's own 月次 show Q1 FY5/27 (Jun-Aug 2026) 確認済 19,771 vs 19,099 (+3.5%), 完了検査 15,513 vs 15,032 (+3.2%), 中間検査 4,145 vs 3,771 (+9.9%). Building-confirmation revenue per case is flat since the law change (Q1 FY26 ¥70.0k, Q4 FY26 ¥70.2k), so that line grows only with volume. Completion-inspection revenue per case keeps rising as post-April-2025 approvals complete: Q1 FY26 ¥56.9k, Q2-Q3 ¥66.6k, Q4 ¥69.0k. That is about +¥170-200m of Q1 inspection revenue on unchanged staff. Estimate: Q1 revenue about ¥5.9bn (+9-10%), ordinary about ¥950-1,050m vs a ¥938m seasonal bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual print reactions on the Yahoo tape (close before → next close): Q1 FY25 2024-09-30 +1.0%. Q1 FY26 2025-09-30 +17.0%, locked limit-up, with a buyback announced at the same time. H1 FY26 2025-12-26 −2.2% (pre-released by the 12-16 速報値 and revision, which itself went limit-up +18.0%). Q3 FY26 2026-03-30 −15.1% on 1.0m shares: 76.6% progress and no raise. FY26 2026-07-14 +7.5% (beat, raised mid-term plan). Record quarters without a raise have been sold.

findings.why_not_priced: The monthly case counts are public, so the volume half is probably priced. The price move since they were posted is consistent with that: down from ¥1,625 on 9/7 to ¥1,518 on 9/11, and back up only on the 防災庁 theme article of 9/24. The per-case revenue split is not in the 月次. It has to be rebuilt from four presentations, and there is no quarterly consensus on this ¥40bn Standard-market name. If the market had priced a double-digit-growth Q1 above the seasonal bar, the pre-print tape would show buying into the date on volume. Instead the rise came on theme days (9/28 at 88k shares), and the stock is −2.7% intraday on the print day.
findings.independence: Partly independent: MLIT 建築着工統計 for July 2026 shows the housing investment estimate +19.5% YoY (https://www.mlit.go.jp/report/press/joho04_hh_001390.html). That fits volumes recovering off the post-revision trough. The counts and the per-case revenue both come from the company's own documents, so they count once.

baseline_tension: The finding is mildly positive and runs against the priced lean (−0.50, crowded margin longs). The run-up (+1.0% 20d, +2.8% 5d, all-time-high intraday 9/29) is theme-driven rather than earnings-driven. A modest beat on a stock with an 8x margin-long overhang and a history of selling record prints without a raise nets out close to zero.
